"All Out" was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW). It took place on September 5, 2021, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois. Some key highlights of the event include:

1. Kenny Omega defeated Christian Cage to retain the AEW World Championship

2. The Young Bucks (Matt and Nick Jackson) defended their AEW Tag Team Championship

3. Chris Jericho defeated MJF in a significant match

4. CM Punk made his long-awaited return to professional wrestling in this event, wrestling his first match in seven years against Darby Allin

The event was notable for being CM Punk's first wrestling match since 2014, which generated significant fan excitement. It was part of AEW's build-up of storylines and was considered an important event in the promotion's history.

Beyond these basic details, I want to be transparent that I'm not completely certain of every specific match result or nuance of the event. If you're looking for comprehensive details, I recommend consulting wrestling-specific sources or event archives.
